title: The Turning of Kunti Against the Seedbearer
causes: Shukradeva and Daedrasura's hold over Kunti, who has no agency of her own
Jambanson's memory-seed work spreading faster than the Asuras could unmake it
outcomes: Kunti is set against the Seedbearer of the South and made to unpick his restorative work
The conflict is remembered as the tricked goddess's, though none of it was her doing
summary: Weaponised by the Asura guru Shukradeva and by Daedrasura, the celestial nymph Kunti is turned against Jambanson and made to disrupt his ecological and ancestral memory-seed magic. She is the instrument and not the author of it, which is the whole of her tragedy: the Land of Myst remembers her as the tricked goddess.
